name: Turkey and Bean Chilli with Rice
method: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the chopped onion and pepper for 5 minutes. Add the turkey mince and fry for 5 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Stir in the paprika and cumin for 1 minute, then add the chopped tomatoes and drained kidney beans.
Simmer for 20 minutes until thick and the turkey is cooked through. Season with salt and pepper.
Meanwhile cook the rice to the packet instructions and drain. Spoon the chilli over the rice and serve.
